about_the_game:
A refreshing action Open World RPG, with retro fantasy ambience and unique physics-driven gameplay. In Hybrid Blood you can remember those old time 3d console games but with modern combat mechanics and playstyle.

Wake up, hybrid! Reclaim your domain.

  • Defeat enemies packed with diverse mechanics: In Hybrid Blood, each encounter has the potential to introduce new mechanics. Enemy NPCs aren’t just mindless attackers; they’re equipped with abilities a player could have. They can dodge, interact with the environment, coordinate with others, and force you to approach each fight with caution and strategy.

  • Expand your domain: As a Hybrid, defeating enemies expands your Vampiric Domain, granting access to higher stat levels and unlocking new abilities. This progression functions similarly to classic character leveling systems with some additions you will discover in-game.

  • A world full of engaging, additive interactions: The world of Hybrid Blood is filled with dynamic items—most can be interacted with in various ways or at least destroyed. They can also interact with each other, creating emergent gameplay possibilities.

content_descriptors.notes: It may contain elements resembling blood or occasional use of explicit language.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 (2.7 GHz 4 Core) / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X (3.5 GHz 4 Core) or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (req. 6GB VRAM) / AMD Radeon RX 580 (req. 6GB VRAM) / Intel ARC A380
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: On board

short_description: Step into the role of a Vampire-Human Hybrid, imprisoned for longer than you can remember. Explore a Open-world RPG and expand your Vampiric Domain. Defeat the local Vampire Lord to claim his territory and begin your quest to dominate—or liberate—the lands.
supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America
